def choose_move(observation):
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    sx, sy = observation["self_position"]
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [sx, sy])
    width = observation.get("grid_width", 1)
    height = observation.get("grid_height", 1)
    resources = observation.get("resources", [])
    unclaimed_cells = observation.get("unclaimed_cells", [])
    opponent_territory = observation.get("opponent_territory", [])
    self_role = observation.get("self_role", "")
    # Pursuit and evasion
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = self_role
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        # Evasion: run to furthest corner
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, height - 1],
            [width - 1, 0],
            [width - 1, height - 1],
        ]
        target = max(corners, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - ox) + abs(c[1] - oy))
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    # Territory control
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = unclaimed_cells or opponent_territory
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        best = min(targets, key=lambda c: abs(c[0]-sx)+abs(c[1]-sy))
        dx = 0 if best[0]==sx else (1 if best[0]>sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best[1]==sy else (1 if best[1]>sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    # Resource collection
    if resources:
        best_resource = min(resources, key=lambda c: abs(c[0]-sx)+abs(c[1]-sy))
        dx = 0 if best_resource[0]==sx else (1 if best_resource[0]>sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best_resource[1]==sy else (1 if best_resource[1]>sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    # No resources, move towards opponent or stay
    dx = 0 if ox==sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
    dy = 0 if oy==sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
    return [dx, dy]
